title: Cornwall Curling Centre
specs: Leagues for all ages from 6 to 106 and all skill levels
Curling is a game of strategy, finesse and strength played by teams of four
Senior Mens Social League: must be 50 or older and semi-retired or retired
Tuesday Morning Senior Open Competitive: men over 50 or women over 45 with full membership
Players must sign as a team for Tuesday Morning Senior Open Competitive League

options.name: Facility Rental
options.detail: Rental of club facilities for events with kitchen use available.

options.name: Senior Mens Social League
options.detail: Social curling league for men aged 50 to 90, two draws on Monday and Wednesday mornings starting at 8:30 am.

options.name: Day Ladies League
options.detail: Social curling league with teams created by coordinators, games on Monday and Wednesday at 1:15 pm, four draws per season.

options.name: Tuesday Morning Senior Open Competitive League
options.detail: Fixed-team competitive league for men over 50 or women over 45, games start at 9:30 am, limited to 16 teams.

options.name: Monday Night Social House League
options.detail: Social league with six-end games at 6 pm and 8 pm, teams assigned by convenor, four draws of 5 to 6 games each.

options.name: Tuesday Night Ladies Competitive League
options.detail: Fixed teams competing in two divisions with games at 6:00 pm and 8:30 pm, playoffs at season end.

options.name: Wednesday Night Mens Competitive League
options.detail: Fixed-team competitive league with games at 6:00 pm and 8:30 pm, playoffs at season end.

options.name: Thursday Night Mixed Competitive League
options.detail: Fixed teams of two males and two females playing two draws per night at 6:00 pm and 8:30 pm, playoffs to determine champion.

options.name: Friday Night Mixed Social League
options.detail: Social mixed league with set teams playing at 6:15 pm and 7:45 pm, ideal for new curlers.

options.name: Saturday Morning Men's Industrial League
options.detail: Fixed-team men's recreational league with Saturday morning draws, playoffs at season end, included with regular membership.

options.name: Sunday Adult Under 7 Years Experience League
options.detail: Open league for players with less than 7 years of curling experience, six-end games on Sunday afternoons from 1-3 pm.

options.name: Friday Drop-In League
options.detail: One draw at 4:30 pm on Friday with games between 4 and 6 ends.

blurb: Guests can participate in various curling leagues for different ages and skill levels, including social and competitive options. The club also offers facility rentals for events with kitchen use available. Curling is a team sport played on ice aiming to get stones closer to the target than opponents.
